# openmetadata_document (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata document by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_document" "getting_started" {
  fully_qualified_name = "getting-started.acceptance"
}

output "getting_started_document_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_document.getting_started.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Document fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Document UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) Document payload as compact JSON with sorted keys.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `entity_type` (String) Document flavour, for example KnowledgePanel.
- `name` (String) Document name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
